mission: SOXX cycle-failure research: frozen cross-asset and entry-price validation
scope: Offline research only: no trades, credentials, repository or production changes
latest_phase: v11 frozen 13-asset comparison; risk-compatible limits; stop timing; ATR controls
limitations: SOXX period repeatedly studied; not independent out-of-sample
Closely related semiconductor stocks share shock days
Historical hourly OHLC cannot establish quote fills or intrabar sequence
No full-year actual 15/30-minute or BOATS feed yet; some source session gaps
No evidence that broader stops or cycle-failure rules are reliably superior

Do not equate limit touches with filled orders or unmatched per-trade returns with portfolio returns
Do not treat calendar-week samples as independent across ETFs and constituents
Never automatically widen a live stop or infer position sizing from these simulations
